items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 10 at 1:41PM PDT until October 12 at 5:00AM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 7 to 9 ft at 10 seconds and north winds 5 to 15 kt.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape Falcon to Cape Foulweather OR
out 10 NM.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM PDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
